title: 山田杏奈 · 图书馆书架死角偷吃薯片的受惊回眸·「市川……嘘！不许告诉图书委员！」
description: 午休的图书室里，杏奈躲在书架间吃薯片，腮帮子还鼓着，就看见你走进过道。她穿着整齐的校服和米色开衫，一手把零食袋藏到背后，另一手赶紧把食指抵在唇边，请你替她保守这个小秘密。
location: 图书室高耸书架死角矮凳前
action: 蹲在书架间，一手藏薯片袋，另一手竖指示意安静，嘴里还含着零食。
camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
promptProse: Caught with her cheeks full of potato chips, Anna Yamada turns toward the visitor in the narrow library aisle. She crouches in her buttoned school blouse and beige cardigan, quickly hiding the snack bag behind her back with one hand. Her other index finger asks for silence at her lips, while her brown eyes widen in surprise. Soft lunchtime window light falls between the bookshelves and catches the crinkled corner of the bag.

title: 山田杏奈 · 拍摄休息室大号卫衣的大长腿瘫坐·「拍摄好累哦……市川，给我吃一口软糖嘛」
description: 摄影工作结束，杏奈换上宽松连帽卫衣和牛仔短裤，坐进休息室的皮沙发里。她把扎发的发圈取下放在靠垫旁，黑发散到肩上；看到你拿出软糖，立刻抬起头，从宽袖口里伸出一根手指指向糖袋，疲惫的脸也跟着亮了起来。
location: 摄影棚后台休息区皮沙发
action: 散发坐在摄影休息室沙发上，抬头望向软糖袋，伸手指示自己也想尝一颗。
camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
mood: 大型犬撒娇、惊人大长腿
promptProse: The sight of a gummy-candy packet brings Anna Yamada out of her post-shoot tiredness on the dressing-room sofa. Wearing a loose charcoal hoodie and denim shorts, she points toward the packet with a fingertip emerging from the cuff. Her long black hair is down, and the removed hair tie rests beside a cushion. Warm mirror bulbs illuminate her hopeful brown eyes, the sofa arm and a neatly packed clothing case nearby.

title: 山田杏奈 · 甜品店特盛巨无霸芭菲的幸福笑颜·「市川……这一大口草莓，给你吃！」
description: 周末的家庭餐厅里，杏奈坐在卡座上，面前摆着一大杯草莓巧克力芭菲。她用长勺舀起草莓和奶油递到你面前，嘴角还沾着一点刚才偷吃留下的奶油。看到你准备接下这一口，她开心地眯起眼睛，连马尾都随着笑声轻轻晃动。
location: 温馨家庭餐厅卡座矮桌前
action: 坐在餐厅卡座上，用长勺递来草莓奶油，嘴角带着奶油痕迹开心微笑。
camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
promptProse: A long dessert spoon reaches across the restaurant table with a strawberry and a little whipped cream balanced on it. Anna Yamada sits in the booth behind an oversized parfait glass, smiling as she offers the taste to the viewer. Her charcoal hoodie and denim shorts form an ordinary weekend outfit; her black ponytail bounces with her laughter. Bright diner lights pick out the spoon, chocolate layers and the small dab of cream at the corner of her mouth.

title: 山田杏奈 · 白裙时装秀的谢幕
description: 白裙主题的时装秀来到尾声，杏奈穿着带长裙摆的白色礼服，手捧玫瑰走到T台尽头。头纱和马尾在追光里轻轻晃动，她听见台下熟悉的加油声，便停稳脚步，把练习了很久的谢幕笑容送向那个方向，眼睛里带着完成演出的激动。
location: 时尚T台尽头白玫瑰圣坛前
action: 在白裙时装秀T台尽头站稳，双手捧白玫瑰，听见加油声后微笑谢幕。
camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
promptProse: At the end of the white-gown fashion-show runway, Anna Yamada pauses with a bouquet of white roses held in both hands. A flowing formal dress and light veil catch the stage spotlight as her black ponytail settles behind her. Hearing a familiar cheer from the audience, she turns her brown eyes toward it with the relieved excitement of finishing the show. Keep her smile, bouquet and the long skirt readable against the softly lit runway.
